regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, government-linked technology, and healthcare, but several clusters rely partly on sentiment or affiliation rather than harder transaction signals. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains modest despite unusually broad alignment in MU and PLTR.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号集中于半导体、政府相关科技和医疗板块，但部分聚类仍依赖情绪或关联信号，而非更硬的交易数据。由于尚无已评分战绩，即使MU与PLTR呈现较广泛的异常共振，整体置信度仍应保持克制。

theses.thesis: The strongest non-extended alignment combines net buying by four congressional members [congress_cluster], uniformly positive measured insider pressure [insider_mspr], accelerating federal grants [gov_grant_accel], and a substantial patent cluster [patent_cluster]. CNBC and Stocktwits enthusiasm broaden attention but are weaker, potentially crowded confirmation channels [cnbc_pick] [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: 最强的未延伸共振来自四名国会议员的净买入[congress_cluster]、一致为正的内部人士买卖压力[insider_mspr]、加速的联邦拨款[gov_grant_accel]以及显著的专利集群[patent_cluster]。CNBC与Stocktwits的乐观情绪扩大了关注度，但属于较弱且可能拥挤的辅助信号[cnbc_pick] [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: Semiconductor-memory equipment theme — stronger memory investment would pass through to fabrication and packaging suppliers
Data-center memory theme — demand strength implied by MU would support the broader high-bandwidth-memory supply chain
theses.dissent: MU has underperformed SPY by 13.9 percentage points over 60 days, so the signals may reflect attempts to catch a deteriorating memory cycle rather than an early turn.

falsifier.text: Congressional and insider buying fails to persist while federal-grant acceleration reverses and relative performance continues weakening.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: Federal-contract activity and acceleration provide the principal hard signal [gov_contract], while a uniformly bullish analyst cluster adds institutional confirmation [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm reinforce momentum but raise crowding risk [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]; the disclosed MTG holding and Cathie Wood affiliation expand the influence graph without proving incremental demand [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood].
theses.thesis_zh: 联邦合同活动及其加速构成主要硬信号[gov_contract]，一致看多的分析师集群提供机构侧确认[analyst_upgrade_cluster]。散户与Stocktwits热度强化动量，但也增加拥挤风险[retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]；MTG披露持仓和Cathie Wood关联扩大了影响力网络，却不能证明新增需求[actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。
second_order: Government-software theme — sustained PLTR contract growth would imply broader public-sector digitization spending
Defense-data infrastructure theme — expanding deployments would benefit secure cloud, networking, and systems-integration suppliers
theses.dissent: The Trump-linked signal is explicitly on the sell side, while much of the remaining convergence is analyst or retail enthusiasm that may already be reflected after 20.4 percentage points of relative outperformance.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract activity decelerates materially and analyst sentiment turns while retail attention remains elevated.

theses.thesis: Ten Phase 3 starts [clinical_phase3_start], an FDA label-expansion signal [fda_label_expansion], substantial lobbying activity [lobbying], and a Trump-linked buy signal [trump] align around regulatory and pipeline catalysts. The recently introduced cancer-care legislation is directionally relevant to oncology utilization, but it is only introduced and does not establish a company-specific benefit [bill:HR10087].
theses.thesis_zh: 十项三期临床启动[clinical_phase3_start]、FDA标签扩展信号[fda_label_expansion]、显著游说活动[lobbying]以及特朗普关联买入信号[trump]共同指向监管与研发管线催化剂。近期提出的癌症护理法案在方向上有利于肿瘤治疗服务需求，但目前仅处于提出阶段，且不能证明MRK会获得公司层面的特定收益[bill:HR10087]。
second_order: Oncology diagnostics theme — broader cancer-care planning can increase testing and treatment-selection activity
Clinical-research services theme — a larger late-stage pipeline implies demand for trial operations and regulatory support
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts create meaningful pipeline-quality risk, and 28.5 percentage points of relative outperformance leaves less entry margin before the position becomes extended.

falsifier.text: Clinical halts broaden, label-expansion progress stalls, or the late-stage programs fail to advance on schedule.

theses.thesis: Large measured app engagement [app_demand], strong developer and model-download activity [github_momentum], and a sizeable patent cluster [patent_cluster] align across consumer demand, developer adoption, and intellectual-property creation. The factual Sam Altman partnership adds strategic relevance [actor:Sam Altman], while the Bill Ackman affiliation is qualitative and should receive little weight [actor:Bill Ackman].
theses.thesis_zh: 大规模应用参与度[app_demand]、强劲的开发者及模型下载活动[github_momentum]和可观的专利集群[patent_cluster]在消费者需求、开发者采用与知识产权创造三个维度形成共振。与Sam Altman的事实性合作增加战略相关性[actor:Sam Altman]，而Bill Ackman关联属于定性信息，权重应较低[actor:Bill Ackman]。
second_order: Cloud data-center infrastructure theme — sustained software and AI adoption implies additional compute, networking, and power demand
Enterprise AI-services theme — developer momentum supports implementation, security, and data-governance providers
theses.dissent: The cluster lacks fresh buying, contract acceleration, or another transaction-based signal, so usage and developer activity may not translate into incremental earnings within the horizon.

falsifier.text: App engagement and developer-download momentum roll over without corresponding commercial adoption.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
